description: Physical top-k/top-(k+1) energy gate calibrated separately for each model and learned featurizer to match paired-head reconstruction error on primitive+AND validation. k and threshold use head energy only, no labels/logits/XOR. Independently evaluate calibrated physical and learned featurizer on identical uniform and shifted XOR panels, seeds 0–4 exploratory, seeds 5–9 independent confirmation. Achieved XOR head errors can differ after the whole-family shift.
